description: Finds auspicious date-and-time windows in the coming weeks for an activity in a city: a wedding or engagement, house-warming, business launch, travel, signing, buying property or a vehicle, a job start, starting studies, or a medical procedure. Each window is clear of Rahu Kaal, Yamaganda, Gulika, Varjyam, Dur Muhurtam and Bhadra, and is given with its star, tithi, Choghadiya and the reasons it qualifies. With birth details it also applies the person's Tara Bala and Chandra Bala. Use it when someone asks for a good date or time to do something. A wedding, house-warming or vehicle window also respects the season rules of the muhurat calendar.

activity.description: What the time is for. Use general for anything else important.

birth_date.description: Optional. Date of birth as YYYY-MM-DD. Give it together with birth_time and birth_place to make the answer personal. People write dates in different orders: day first in India and most countries, month first in the United States. Convert what the person wrote to YYYY-MM-DD yourself. If an all-number date could be read two ways, such as 05-06-1990, ask which number is the day before calling; never assume.

birth_latitude.description: Optional. Latitude of the birth place, north positive. Only together with birth_longitude.

birth_longitude.description: Optional. Longitude of the birth place, east positive. Only together with birth_latitude.

birth_place.description: Optional. City and country of birth, for example "Mumbai, India".

birth_time.description: Optional. Local clock time of birth, 24-hour HH:MM. If the person gave an hour from 1 to 12 without AM or PM, ask which before calling. Ask the user if the time is unknown; do not guess it.

days.description: Optional. How many days ahead to search, 7 to 45. Defaults to 30.

latitude.description: Optional. Latitude of the city in decimal degrees, north positive. Give it only together with longitude, when the user supplied coordinates or the place could not be found by name.

longitude.description: Optional. Longitude of the city in decimal degrees, east positive. Give it only together with latitude.

place.description: City and country where it will happen, for example "Pune, India".

name: find_muhurat
title: Find auspicious times (muhurat)
